protocol.intervention: Default-off atlas.faSupport vetoes logical fa template proposals with less than half their expected foreground pixels having non-neutralized in-bounds observations. Majority-support criterion fixed before run, no threshold sweep. No ordinary-head veto or bar change. V6 native-hole rule fixed on.
protocol.rationale: V5 shows heavy neutralization while V4 source review found source-empty retained centers; V6 improves triangle fill to54/60 but further increases retained unmatched heads and reference insertions. Test minimum observable fa foreground coverage rather than tune distance threshold.
protocol.comparison: Same binary fa-off reference, V6-equivalent fa-on/support-off, fa-on/support-on. Same read-only FASUPPORT7 logging across arms at 234 frozen benchmark +21 frozen review centers.
